description_en: Invokes the UpdateAcceleratorCrossBorderMode operation to modify the transmission network quality type of an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateAcceleratorCrossBorderMode接口修改全球加速实例的传输网络质量类型
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-accelerator-cross-border-mode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --cross-border-mode bgpPro --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAcceleratorCrossBorderMode

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

The Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance must use the pay-by-data-transfer bandwidth billing method
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例ID。

该全球加速实例需为按流量的带宽计费方式
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The transmission network quality type of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

<props="china">
bgpPro: premium bandwidth cross-border acceleration. Uses BGP premium lines for cross-border network acceleration. Compared with China Unicom dedicated line cross-border acceleration, this type simplifies the cross-border qualification approval flow.</props>
<props="china">
private: China Unicom cross-border dedicated line acceleration. Uses China Unicom dedicated lines. Compared with premium bandwidth cross-border acceleration, this type provides better acceleration performance but requires cross-border compliance certification and China Unicom cross-border business qualifications.</props>
<props="intl">
bgpPro: premium bandwidth cross-border acceleration. Uses BGP premium lines for cross-border network acceleration. Compared with cross-border dedicated lines, this type simplifies the enterprise real-name registration flow.</props>
<props="intl">
private: cross-border acceleration over dedicated lines. Uses cross-border dedicated lines. Compared with premium bandwidth cross-border acceleration, this type provides better acceleration performance but requires enterprise real-name verification.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的传输网络质量类型。取值：

<props="china">
bgpPro：精品带宽跨境加速。使用BGP精品线路，实现跨境网络加速。相比联通专线跨境，简化了跨境资质审批流程。</props>
<props="china">
private：联通跨境专线加速。使用联通专线线路，相比精品带宽跨境，加速效果更好，但需要进行跨境合规认证，申请联通跨境业务资质。</props>
<props="intl">
bgpPro：精品带宽跨域加速。使用BGP精品线路，实现跨境网络加速。相比跨域专线线路，简化了企业实名登记流程。</props>
<props="intl">
private：专线跨域加速。使用跨域专线线路，相比精品带宽跨域，加速效果更好，但需要进行企业实名认证。</props>
parameters.name: cross_border_mode
